  - tweet_id

parameters.query:
=// ⑦ Graph DB (Neo4j) - Event 노드 생성

MERGE (e:Event {
  tweet_id: $tweet_id
})
SET 
  e.event_type = $event_type,
  e.player = $player,
  e.team = $team,
  e.status = $status,
  e.reason = $reason,
  e.game = $game,
  e.confidence = $confidence,
  e.raw_text = $raw_text,
  e.tweet_author = $tweet_author,
  e.tweet_created_at = datetime($tweet_created_at),
  e.processed_at = datetime($processed_at)

// 선수와 연결 (존재하면)
WITH e
WHERE $player IS NOT NULL
MATCH (p:Player {name: $player})
MERGE (e)-[:AFFECTS_PLAYER]->(p)

// 팀과 연결 (존재하면)
WITH e
WHERE $team IS NOT NULL
MATCH (t:Team {abbreviation: $team})
MERGE (e)-[:AFFECTS_TEAM]->(t)

RETURN e

nodes.name: Neo4j - Event 저장
nodes.notes:
⑦ Graph DB 저장

노드 생성:
- Event (tweet_id 기준 중복 방지)

관계 생성:
- AFFECTS_PLAYER → Player
- AFFECTS_TEAM → Team

parameters.query:
=// ⑧ Context 재계산 - 유사 과거 사건 검색

MATCH (e:Event {tweet_id: $tweet_id})
MATCH (e)-[:AFFECTS_PLAYER]->(p:Player)

// 같은 선수의 과거 OUT 기록
MATCH (past:Event)-[:AFFECTS_PLAYER]->(p)
WHERE past.status = 'OUT' 
  AND past.tweet_id <> e.tweet_id
  AND past.tweet_created_at < e.tweet_created_at
WITH e, p, past
ORDER BY past.tweet_created_at DESC
LIMIT 10

// 해당 선수가 OUT일 때 팀 성적
MATCH (p)-[:PLAYS_FOR]->(t:Team)
MATCH (g:Game)-[:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t)
WHERE g.date > past.tweet_created_at 
  AND g.date < e.tweet_created_at

RETURN 
  e.tweet_id as current_event,
  p.name as player,
  count(DISTINCT past) as past_out_count,
  count(DISTINCT g) as games_since_last_out,
  collect(DISTINCT {date: past.tweet_created_at, reason: past.reason})[0..5] as recent_outs
